tools.name: get_space_note_tree
tools.title: Get a space note
tools.description: Retrieve the full notes tree of a space's notebook: the root (home) note and every nested note with their ids. Use it to find a note id or a parent note id before other note tools.

space_id.description: Id of the space whose notes tree to read (the numeric 'space_id' from get_my_spaces / get_all_spaces). This is NOT a space name, a group id, or a note id. Resolve the name to its id first, or ask the user which space they mean.

tools.name: get_note
tools.title: Get a note
tools.description: Get a single note by its ID.

note_id.description: Id of the note (the numeric 'note_id' returned by get_note, search_notes, get_space_note_tree or a create_* tool). This is NOT a space id, a user id, or a note title. If you only know the note by title or subject, find its id with search_notes or get_space_note_tree first; if that fails, ask the user which note they mean rather than guessing.

language.description: Optional language/translation to read (e.g. 'fr', 'de'); omit for the note's default content. Use get_note_translations to list which languages exist.

tools.name: create_space_note
tools.title: Create a note in a space
tools.description: Create a new note at the root of a SPACE's notebook. Use it only when the user named a space (or its id is known); for a note nested under an existing note use create_child_note.

space_id.description: Id of the space (the numeric 'space_id' from get_my_spaces / get_all_spaces / get_space_by_id). This is NOT a space name, a group id, a user id, or a note id, and 0 is never a valid value. Resolve the space name to its id first; if the user did not name a space, ask them which space instead of guessing.

title.description: Title of the note, plain text (no HTML, no markdown). Shown in the notes tree and on cards; keep it short. Ask the user for a title if none was given rather than inventing one.

summary.description: Optional short plain-text summary (excerpt) shown on note cards and previews. Text only: no HTML, no markdown. Stored as note metadata, this is NOT the note body; do not repeat the whole content here.

html_content.description: The note BODY, as HTML (markdown is also accepted and converted). This is the main content the user reads when opening the note; do not put the summary here, and do not put the title here (it is a separate parameter).

tools.name: create_child_note
tools.title: Create a note under another note
tools.description: Create a new note as a child of an existing note. The child is created in the same notebook (space or personal) as its parent; there is no separate space or owner parameter.

parent_note_id.description: Id of the existing note under which the new note is nested (a 'note_id' from get_space_note_tree, get_note, search_notes or a create_* tool). This is NOT a space id: to create a note at the root of a space use create_space_note. If unknown, look it up or ask the user rather than guessing.

title.description: Title of the note, plain text (no HTML, no markdown). Shown in the notes tree and on cards; keep it short. Ask the user for a title if none was given rather than inventing one.

summary.description: Optional short plain-text summary (excerpt) shown on note cards and previews. Text only: no HTML, no markdown. Stored as note metadata, this is NOT the note body; do not repeat the whole content here.

html_content.description: The note BODY, as HTML (markdown is also accepted and converted). This is the main content the user reads when opening the note; do not put the summary here, and do not put the title here (it is a separate parameter).

tools.name: update_note
tools.title: Update a note
tools.description: Update an existing note's title OR its content (one per call, not both). Replaces the previous value entirely; with a 'language' it creates or updates that translation instead of the default content.

note_id.description: Id of the note (the numeric 'note_id' returned by get_note, search_notes, get_space_note_tree or a create_* tool). This is NOT a space id, a user id, or a note title. If you only know the note by title or subject, find its id with search_notes or get_space_note_tree first; if that fails, ask the user which note they mean rather than guessing.

title.description: New title of the note, plain text. Provide either 'title' or 'html_content' in one call, not both. Omit it when only the content changes.

html_content.description: New BODY of the note as HTML (markdown accepted); it REPLACES the whole existing body, so include everything the note must keep. Provide either 'html_content' or 'title' in one call, not both.

language.description: Optional language code (e.g. 'en', 'fr') of the translation to create or update; omit to update the note's default content. Use get_note_translations to see which languages exist.

tools.name: publish_note
tools.title: Publish a note
tools.description: Publish a note: posts it as an activity in its space's activity stream so members see it. The note itself already exists; this does not create or change its content.

note_id.description: Id of the note (the numeric 'note_id' returned by get_note, search_notes, get_space_note_tree or a create_* tool). This is NOT a space id, a user id, or a note title. If you only know the note by title or subject, find its id with search_notes or get_space_note_tree first; if that fails, ask the user which note they mean rather than guessing.

tools.name: delete_note
tools.title: Delete a note
tools.description: Delete a note by its ID.

note_id.description: Id of the note to delete (a 'note_id' from get_note, search_notes or get_space_note_tree). This deletes the whole note, its translations and its child notes; to remove only one translation use remove_note_translation. Confirm with the user which note is meant if there is any ambiguity.

tools.name: move_note
tools.title: Move a note
tools.description: Move a note under another parent note.

note_id.description: Id of the note to move (a 'note_id' from get_note, search_notes or get_space_note_tree). NOT the destination.

target_parent_note_id.description: Id of the note that becomes the new parent (a 'note_id'); the moved note is nested under it. This is NOT a space id: to move a note to the root of a space's notebook, pass the id of that space's root note from get_space_note_tree. Ask the user for the destination if it is unclear.

tools.name: search_notes
tools.title: Search for notes
tools.description: Full-text search over the notes the current user can read (space notebooks and their own personal notebook), returning matching notes with their ids. Use it to find a note id from words in its title or content.

query.description: Words to search for in note titles and contents. Plain text, not a regular expression and not a note id.

space_id.description: Optional id of a space (numeric 'space_id') to restrict the search to that space's notebook. Omit it (do not pass 0) to search everywhere the user can read. NOT a space name or a note id.

offset.description: Optional number of results to skip, for paging (default 0).

limit.description: Optional maximum number of results to return (default 10).

is_favorites.description: Optional; true restricts the results to the notes the current user marked as favorites. Omit or false otherwise.

tools.name: get_note_versions
tools.title: Get a note's version history
tools.description: List the version history of a note: each version's number, id, title, content, date and author. Use restore_note_version to roll back to one.

note_id.description: Id of the note (the numeric 'note_id' returned by get_note, search_notes, get_space_note_tree or a create_* tool). This is NOT a space id, a user id, or a note title. If you only know the note by title or subject, find its id with search_notes or get_space_note_tree first; if that fails, ask the user which note they mean rather than guessing.

language.description: Optional note language/translation to target (e.g. 'en', 'fr'); omit for the default note.

tools.name: restore_note_version
tools.title: Restore a note version
tools.description: Restore a note to a previous version identified by its version_number (from get_note_versions). Creates a new current version from the chosen one.

note_id.description: Id of the note (the numeric 'note_id' returned by get_note, search_notes, get_space_note_tree or a create_* tool). This is NOT a space id, a user id, or a note title. If you only know the note by title or subject, find its id with search_notes or get_space_note_tree first; if that fails, ask the user which note they mean rather than guessing.

version_number.description: The version_number to restore, from get_note_versions.

language.description: Optional note language/translation to target (e.g. 'en', 'fr'); omit for the default note.

tools.name: set_note_cover
tools.title: Set a note's cover image
tools.description: Set a note's cover (featured) image from a public image URL or base64 bytes. The image is wired into the note so it actually renders as the note's illustration.

note_id.description: Id of the note (the numeric 'note_id' returned by get_note, search_notes, get_space_note_tree or a create_* tool). This is NOT a space id, a user id, or a note title. If you only know the note by title or subject, find its id with search_notes or get_space_note_tree first; if that fails, ask the user which note they mean rather than guessing.

image_url.description: Direct http(s) URL of an image to use as the cover. Provide exactly one image source.

image_base64.description: Base64-encoded image bytes (png, jpeg, gif or webp), optionally as a data: URI. Provide exactly one image source.

attachment_object_type.description: Internal: object type of an existing platform attachment to use as the cover (set automatically by the client from the user's attached image — do not fill this yourself). Read as the current user, so its ACL is enforced.

attachment_object_id.description: Internal: object id of an existing platform attachment to use as the cover (set automatically by the client — do not fill this yourself). Provide exactly one image source: attachment_object_id, image_url or image_base64.

alt_text.description: Optional accessibility description of the cover image.

language.description: Optional note language/translation to target (e.g. 'en', 'fr'); omit for the default note.

note_id.description: Id of the note (the numeric 'note_id' returned by get_note, search_notes, get_space_note_tree or a create_* tool). This is NOT a space id, a user id, or a note title. If you only know the note by title or subject, find its id with search_notes or get_space_note_tree first; if that fails, ask the user which note they mean rather than guessing.

language.description: Optional note language/translation to target (e.g. 'en', 'fr'); omit for the default note.

tools.name: set_note_summary
tools.title: Set a note's summary
tools.description: Set (or replace) a note's summary — the short excerpt shown on note cards and previews. The note's cover image is preserved.

note_id.description: Id of the note (the numeric 'note_id' returned by get_note, search_notes, get_space_note_tree or a create_* tool). This is NOT a space id, a user id, or a note title. If you only know the note by title or subject, find its id with search_notes or get_space_note_tree first; if that fails, ask the user which note they mean rather than guessing.

summary.description: The summary text to set. Pass an empty string to clear it.

language.description: Optional note language/translation to target (e.g. 'en', 'fr'); omit for the default note.

tools.name: get_note_translations
tools.title: List a note's translations
tools.description: List the language codes a note has translations for (e.g. ['en','fr']). An empty list means the note has only its default content. Use get_note with a 'language' to read a specific translation, and update_note with a 'language' to create/update one.

note_id.description: Id of the note (the numeric 'note_id' returned by get_note, search_notes, get_space_note_tree or a create_* tool). This is NOT a space id, a user id, or a note title. If you only know the note by title or subject, find its id with search_notes or get_space_note_tree first; if that fails, ask the user which note they mean rather than guessing.

tools.name: remove_note_translation
tools.title: Remove a note's translation
tools.description: Remove ONE language's translation of a note, leaving the note's original content and its other translations intact. Use get_note_translations to list existing languages. To delete the whole note (its original content and all translations) use delete_note instead.

note_id.description: Id of the note (the numeric 'note_id' returned by get_note, search_notes, get_space_note_tree or a create_* tool). This is NOT a space id, a user id, or a note title. If you only know the note by title or subject, find its id with search_notes or get_space_note_tree first; if that fails, ask the user which note they mean rather than guessing.

language.description: The language code of the translation to remove (e.g. 'fr', 'de'). Must be one of the note's existing translations (see get_note_translations); it cannot be the note's original/default language.
